Jainism Portal

Jainism is an Indian religion of Dharma whose doctrine revolves around harmlessness (
ahimsa
) towards every living being. The two major branches (Digambara and Svetambara) of Jainism stimulate self-control (or, 
shramana
, ‘self-reliance’) and spiritual development through a path of peace for the soul to progess to the ultimate goal.
